title: Ellagic acid counteracts ionizing radiation-induced stress resistance decline and lifespan reduction through DAF-16/SKN-1-mediated pathways in C. elegans.
authors: Zhang, Ge; Zhao, Lei; Xuanyuan, Yujie; Han, Zhicheng; Xu, Xiaoying; Mi, Dong; Sun, Yeqing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究鞣花酸通过DAF-16/SKN-1转录因子通路缓解电离辐射损伤，仅含分子对接初步预测EA与TF的相互作用，缺乏TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Ionizing radiation (IR) exposure in deep space environments has emerged as a serious health concern, as it induces persistent oxidative stress and chronic inflammation, ultimately reducing lifespan. Dietary intervention with natural bioactive compounds presents a promising radioprotective strategy. In this study, we demonstrate that ellagic acid (EA) effectively restores lifespan and enhances stress resistance in Caenorhabditis elegans after extremely high-dose IR exposure. Specifically, EA mitigates reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation and reduces oxidative damage levels in C. elegans exposed to high-dose IR, through upregulating antioxidant and innate immune gene expression, and enhancing antioxidant enzyme activity. Molecular docking analyses suggested that EA can probably interact with the transcription factors DAF-16 and SKN-1. Through GFP reporter and loss-of-function experiments, we demonstrated that EA promotes the nuclear accumulation of DAF-16 and SKN-1, thereby triggering downstream antioxidant and immune pathways that collectively enhance stress resistance and mitigate lifespan reduction in C. elegans exposed to high-dose IR. Overall, this work identifies EA as a promising plant-derived natural polyphenolic compound and establish a mechanistic basis for its potential development as a radioprotective intervention.
abstract_zh: 深空环境中的电离辐射（IR）暴露已成为一个严重的健康问题，因为它会诱导持续的氧化应激和慢性炎症，最终缩短寿命。通过天然生物活性化合物进行饮食干预是一种有前景的辐射防护策略。在本研究中，我们证明鞣花酸（EA）能有效恢复极高剂量IR暴露后秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）的寿命并增强其应激抵抗力。具体而言，EA通过上调抗氧化和先天免疫基因表达，并增强抗氧化酶活性，减轻了高剂量IR暴露下线虫体内活性氧（ROS）的积累，并降低了氧化损伤水平。分子对接分析表明，EA可能能与转录因子DAF-16和SKN-1相互作用。通过GFP报告基因和功能缺失实验，我们证明EA促进DAF-16和SKN-1的核积累，从而触发下游抗氧化和免疫通路，共同增强高剂量IR暴露下线虫的应激抵抗力并缓解寿命缩短。总体而言，本研究将EA鉴定为一种有前景的植物来源天然多酚化合物，并为其作为辐射防护干预措施的潜在开发奠定了机制基础。
